fixed.summary: The cook holds a theme's inks on its art as drawn: each piece's stretched centre, its 10th and 90th percentile pixels (a gloss, a grain or a header band included), is a ground of its scheme, and every art slot's ink and every ink role moves in lightness until it holds 4.5:1 there (3:1 for the large-figure inks), not only on the colours the face was painted from. A fill the solve moves takes its own -fg ink along.
A theme's high-contrast layer (prefers-contrast: more) holds its body inks at 7:1 and its large-figure inks at 4.5:1 on the same grounds.
